## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at 90 Brompton Rd.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step into a world where nothing makes sense, yet everything feels real. Walk through the Castle Room with its tricky hallways and Paradox Sofa. Stand in the grand Throne Room and feel like royalty.
>
> Visit Paradox Museum London for unique, educational entertainment suitable for all ages. Walk on the ceiling of a tube station and snap gravity-defying photos. Enter a tube tunnel where walking straight becomes a challenge. Capture fun photos and create lasting memories.
